auftrag: Read the email and the note on the back. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: Out of two hundred applicants, you are one of only eight people who passed our tests.
Please report to the Agent Academy tomorrow at nine o'clock sharp.
We are hidden behind the old bookshop in Fox Lane.
Ring the brass bell twice and give your name to the person who opens the door.
Meet me in the Map Room on the second floor.
Bring your ID card and a printed copy of this email, but leave your phone at home, because phones are not allowed in the building.
Nobody outside may know that the Academy exists, so please do not mention it to your friends, not even by accident.
Something very valuable has disappeared, and we suspect that it was not an accident.
I will explain the details tomorrow.
Until then, trust nobody but me.
The last trainee who was late had to clean all the globes.

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that shows the trainees must keep the Academy secret.
raetsel.hilfe2: It is in the second paragraph, the second sentence.

raetsel.frage: How many applicants were not accepted?
raetsel.hilfe1: Count: two hundred applicants. Eight passed.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “Agent Wren thinks the missing thing disappeared by accident.”
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the sentence that starts with: Something very valuable ...
raetsel.hilfe2: She says: we suspect that it was NOT an accident.
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Why does Agent Wren write: Trust nobody but me?
optionen: She is afraid that somebody inside the Academy is involved.
She wants the trainees to be lonely.
She does not like the other agents' hats.
raetsel.hilfe1: Think: the problem is inside the Academy.
raetsel.hilfe2: If nobody may be trusted, the problem is probably close.

raetsel.frage: Read the short report. Choose the right words.
raetsel.text: Last year the Academy ___ ten trainees. Right now it ___ eight trainees. Tomorrow the trainees ___ their first day.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look at the time words: Last year, Right now, Tomorrow.
raetsel.hilfe2: Think: finished in the past, true now, in the future.
